messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 decode latency spike in us-west-2 for streaming endpoints. Aggregated p99 jumped to 2.8s (baseline 0.9s). SLO alert: streaming-p99-breach. Suspected correlated rollout of kernel 4.2.1 + compiler-flag: -O3-trt.

sre_taylor: seeing it too, p95 up ~200ms, p99 huge. traces show tail during kv-cache refill. Noticed elevated pagefaults on several hosts.

runtime_jun: flagged the kernel+trt rollout at 02:15 UTC in us-west. Rolling forward to all nodes at 02:40. Can we confirm which nodes got the new kernel?

infra_oliver: list from deploy job: gpu-pool-{12,13,14,15}. I'll run live `ssh` checks and post `dmesg`/oom logs.

ops_lead_karin: @here customer impact: CS reported 2 enterprise customers saw streaming sessions stall for ~10s and one retry loop. Beth, any tickets?

cs_beth: yes, customer ACME reported elevated error rates and retries. PS already opened for ACME-2444. They're seeing chat timeouts in EU but replicate in US too.

eng_oncall_luis: quick triage: `perf top` on affected container shows decode kernel spin in FlashAttention kernels during tail tokens. Suspect TRT8 interaction with new compiler flags.

runtime_jun: can someone capture a core dump / `cuda-memcheck`? Also capture `strace -f -p <pid>` for a stalled worker.

sre_taylor: uploading tail traces to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/insights/6473809123 (dashboards + flamegraphs). p99 correlates with two code paths: `flash_attn::forward` and `kv_cache::evict_if_needed`.

infra_oliver: dmesg on gpu-pool-13: `Kernel: page fault in module trt_plugin at 0x...` and repeated warnings about SLAB and page reclaim. Also swap activity increased.

runtime_jun: try temporary mitigation: toggle compiler-flag back to `-O2` or disable TRT-specific fusion for the model. Can we hot-restart runtime on pool-13 to pick older config?

eng_oncall_luis: we can patch the config map: `kubectl -n inference set env ds/runtime COMPILER_FLAGS=-O2 --record` then rolling restart `kubectl rollout restart ds/runtime` for those nodes. Will take ~30s per pod.

ops_lead_karin: schedule: apply to pool-13 first as canary, wait 5 min, then pool-14 if stable. Also change routing: shift 20% traffic to dedicated fallback cluster in us-east for critical customers.

cs_beth: notifying impacted customers with ETA ~30m and mitigation plan. Adding note to support ticket with rollback steps.

prod_telemetry: automations: temporarily disable batching across streaming routes for affected model to reduce tail amplification. This will increase token cost but reduce stalls.

sre_taylor: ran mitigation on pool-13: updated COMPILER_FLAGS and restarted pods. Initial p99 dropped from 2.8s -> 1.1s in 3m. Monitoring p95/p99.

runtime_jun: confirming: after rollback, flashattn calls' CPU wait time decreased. TRT kernels still loaded but fusion disabled; need a plan to repro locally with TRT8 + kernel-4.2.1.

infra_oliver: will snapshot kernel package and driver logs. Opening infra-ticket INFRA-982 to track kernel rollout rollback across the fleet.

eng_oncall_luis: next actions: 1) finish rollbacks on pool-14/15 if metrics stay good; 2) prepare deterministic repro with a smaller model and TRT8 flags; 3) schedule rollback of kernel to 4.1.9 in staged manner.

ops_lead_karin: handoff to next oncall in 45m. If p99 remains >1.5s after full rollback, escalate to oncall+exec and consider full region traffic drain.

cs_beth: customers updated. No major data loss, but UX degraded. Keeping PS on standby.

incident-bot: Incident update posted to #incidents and PagerDuty: PD-6783. Current state: partial mitigation (pool-13), monitoring. p99 now 1.05s (was 2.8s).

sre_taylor: adding retrospective notes: probable root cause interaction between TRT kernel fusions and new kernel page reclaim behavior under heavy KV cache churn. Will draft postmortem once rolling rollback completes.

runtime_jun: assigning follow-ups: RUNTIME-527 (repro + test harness), ENG-TRT-312 (kernel-flag matrix), INFRA-982 (kernel rollback). I'll own RUNTIME-527.

eng_oncall_luis: thanks team — monitoring. Handoff to @sre_taylor in 45m for follow-up checks. :thumbsup:
